## The operational question

Write the decision in language that does not presuppose topology.

## Data and constraints

Include sampling rate, missingness, latency, privacy, computational budget and what ground truth is available.

## Why topology might help

Name the specific structure a conventional summary may miss: connectivity, loops, voids, multiscale organisation or change in a topological signature.
